scripts.build: astro sync --force && astro build && node scripts/optimize-fonts.mjs
scripts.verify: node scripts/migration/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/migration/verify-features.mjs && node scripts/migration/verify-fonts.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests .github astro.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests .github astro.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify
